verdict.rationale: Llama publishes developer documentation, so an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs surface is a fair question to ask, and the axis applies. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at llama.com/llms.txt), and the developer docs pages sat behind an SSO identity wall for a keyless fetch. No evidence shows any agent-oriented documentation an agent could be pointed at.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
